title: Scavenger Hunt in Virginia Beach by 3Quest Challenge
blurb: You'll use an app to explore Virginia Beach in this fun scavenger hunt. Use the app to find things around the city, take photos and collect points. At the end, take a look at the rankings to see your score compared to other teams across the country. All our Scavenger hunts have a live remote host to help along the way. Come out and explore with us in Virginia Beach.
